svg.title: CMMS 2.0 Lab — Work Queue candidate
svg.desc: Provisional CMMS work queue with a decorative industrial hero image, plain-language purpose, refresh control, filters, synthetic metrics and a maintenance work grid.
svg.text: Find maintenance work, review its status, and open its planned actions and execution history.
Choose a metric or filter to narrow results; open a row to inspect planned actions and recorded execution.
Showing 1–4 of 128 · Synthetic demonstration data · Pages 1–32
